mechanism: Adalimumab as a TNF-alpha inhibitor increases risk of opportunistic infections including tuberculosis, which ethambutol is used to treat, requiring careful monitoring for treatment efficacy and immune reconstitution.
action: Monitor for adequate TB treatment response and signs of immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome; ensure baseline and periodic ophthalmic monitoring for ethambutol-related ocular toxicity; consider TB screening before initiating/continuing adalimumab.
